results.question: How do I download this code?
results.reply: You can download this whole repo as a zip. Let me show you the button to click.

results.question: Where can I see the open issues?
results.reply: You can see them in the Issues tab at the top, it shows 17 open right now.

results.question: How do I read this article in another language?
results.reply: Easy, you just use the language picker at the top of the article. Let me show you where it is.

results.question: Where can I see the edit history?
results.reply: It's right at the top of the article. Look for the View history tab.

results.question: Which tool draws a rectangle?
results.reply: It is the little square in the top toolbar.

results.question: How do I add text to the canvas?
results.reply: Click the text tool up top, then click anywhere on the blank canvas and just start typing.

results.question: Where's the main menu to export my drawing?
results.reply: It is the little hamburger button in the top left corner. That opens Export, preferences, and the rest.

results.question: How do I open the extensions marketplace?
results.reply: Click the Extensions icon on the far left sidebar to open the marketplace.

results.question: Where do I search across files?
results.reply: Use the magnifying glass in the far left sidebar. That opens search across files.

results.question: Where is the file explorer?
results.reply: It's already open on the left side of V S Code. Let me show you.
